notes.title: Hotfix December 16 2024
notes.content:
- Fix crash issue at startup for some users
- Increased rewind time for all games

notes.title: Hotfix November 2 2024
notes.content: - Fixed crashing issue on startup when enumerating USB controllers for some users

notes.title: Update Notes for November 1 2024
notes.content:
- Fixed missing samples in Jurassic Park 8-BIT
- Fixed incorrect integer scaling for all games
- Updated crt and dot-matrix filters
- General stability updates.

notes.title: Patch 1 is out now
notes.content:
Patch 1 is now live. It fixes/adds the following:

- Resolution options including the ability to select between Windowed and Full Screen Modes.
- Resolution options are now saved per user.
- Added 'Are you sure' prompt for quitting the application.
- Reduced main menu music.
- Fixed issue with Jurassic Park 8-Bit with 2p Mode selected.
- Fixed Achievement issues.
